title: My mall-world experience
content: This is what I would dream about. I wrote it down when I learned others are having this dream too to make sure I’m not getting my original dreams. driving erratic on a windy roller coaster road type road -dirty toilet stalls or no privacy -hotel elevator -food court at mall -roller coasters -water park -Beach -Airport lobby -auditorium -parking lot -looking for car -old school -school classrooms -old house with many ways to get to various rooms -basement with a bed -mall corridor empty and dimly Lit -grocery store/walmart type store -yard of broken down old country house with lots of green grass -subway train station
